claw.definition:
n. sharp curved horny process on the toe of a bird or some mammals or reptiles
n. a grasping structure on the limb of a crustacean or other arthropods
n. a bird's foot
v. move as if by clawing, seizing, or digging
claw.translation:
n. 爪, 螯, 抓伤
v. 用爪抓, 挖, 搜刮

claw off.translation: 把船头转朝上方, (非正式)狠狠地打击/击败, 责骂

claw-back.translation: n. 加税补偿, 缺点

claw-backs.translation: (claw-back 的复数) n. 加税补偿, 缺点

clawandball.translation: a. 有抓球爪式脚的,有抓球爪式脚的家具的(亦作ball-and-claw)

clawback.definition: n. finding a way to take money back from people that they were given in another way
clawback.translation: 已支付给民众钱款的收回；回收款

clawbacks.definition:
plural of clawback
n. finding a way to take money back from people that they were given in another way
clawbacks.translation: (clawback 的复数)  已支付给民众钱款的收回；回收款

clawed.definition:
s. having or resembling a claw or claws; often used as a combining form
s. (of predatory animals) armed with claws or talons

clawfoot.definition: n. a deformity of the foot characterized by an abnormally high arch and hyperextension of the toes which gives the foot the appearance of a claw

clawhammer.definition: n a hammer with a cleft at one end for pulling nails
clawhammer.translation: a. 抓奏的(指弹奏班卓琴的一种手法)

clawing.definition:
v move as if by clawing, seizing, or digging
v clutch as if in panic
v scratch, scrape, pull, or dig with claws or nails
v attack as if with claws
clawing.translation: vt.& vi. 用爪抓（claw的现在分词形式）

clawings.definition:
plural of clawing
v move as if by clawing, seizing, or digging
v clutch as if in panic
v scratch, scrape, pull, or dig with claws or nails
v attack as if with claws
clawings.translation: (clawing 的复数) vt.& vi. 用爪抓（claw的现在分词形式）

claws.definition:
n sharp curved horny process on the toe of a bird or some mammals or reptiles

n a bird's foot

claws.translation: n. 爪( claw的名词复数 ); （有壳水生动物的）螯; 爪形夹具; （机械的）爪

clawson.translation: [人名] 克劳森; [地名] [美国] 克劳森
